title: From the Old to the New Starobinsky Inflation
summary: Starobinsky's original model of inflation, driven by the trace anomaly of conformal fields, and its $R+R^2$ (scalaron) formulation are often treated separately. The original anomaly-driven evolution connects an early de Sitter phase supported by the Euler anomaly to a scalaron regime, where the observable modes leave the horizon.
